example.title: Beachfront visitor information building, 1299 Ocean Avenue
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1980s oceanfront office and visitor building: a low modernist block of white stucco and glass among tall palms on the bluff, with high-rise office towers behind. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Oceanfront Visitor Ctr.
